title: cps-okf — Concept frontmatter (OKF-CPS profile v0.1)
description: The YAML frontmatter of a single OKF concept, extended for ClearPoint Strategy. Grounded in the real ClearPoint OpenAPI (cps-lucee/api/v1/doc/schema): the `cps` block is the portable, on-disk superset of ClearPoint's own AI-grounding projection (_mcpElement / _mcpElementStatus / _mcpLink). A conforming concept is ALSO a valid base-OKF concept — the only hard requirement is a non-empty `type`, and every extension lives under `cps`, so a base-OKF consumer ignores it. The five axes (structure, access, time, provenance, vocabulary) all live under `cps`.

type.description: Base-OKF required field. Human/canonical kind, e.g. 'Objective'. May be glossary-aliased via cps.alias. Machine-canonical type is cps.object.

tags.description: Base-OKF tags. ClearPoint tags project to STRINGS (see _mcpElement.tags). OKF-CPS convention: namespace as '<dimension>:<value>' (e.g. 'theme:on-time', 'perspective:customer'). Tags are facets, NOT access.

timestamp.description: Base-OKF last-modified (SYSTEM time; maps to element.lastEdited/lastUpdated max). Reporting-period (VALID time) is in cps.time + body period sections.

cps.description: ClearPoint Strategy extension — superset of _mcpElement. A base-OKF consumer ignores this whole key.

objectId.description: AXIS 1. element.objectId; null before creation. Round-trip identity.

parent.description: AXIS 1. Bundle-relative path of the hierarchical parent.

initiativeId.description: AXIS 1. Parent initiative for a milestone.

edges.description: AXIS 1. TYPED edges (superset of the portable markdown links in the body). Mirrors element.links / _mcpLink.

access.description: AXIS 2 — Access. Sourced from element.access (_elementAccess) + cps-next effective access; propagates on rollups/edges (intersection). COMPUTED audit trail, NOT the enforcement point — enforcement is pre-retrieval, server-side, per principal. Default-deny.

markings.description: Compartments: 'scorecard:<id>' (inherits that scorecard's effective-access set), 'personal:<userId>' (never org-served), optional 'domain:<name>'. Derived nodes carry the UNION.

derivedFrom.description: Paths whose markings were unioned into this node.

time.description: AXIS 3 — Time. Bitemporal. Grounding reads VALID time (reporting period). 'current' is PER-ELEMENT at its own cadence.

currentPeriod.description: Latest relevant reporting period (element.displayPeriodId / elementStatus.period), with its status snapshot. Narrative (analysis/recommendations) stays in the body period section.

historyResource.description: Bundle-relative path/URI of the period-history sidecar (structured per-period qualitative: status, analysis, recommendations, period-scoped custom fields). Mirrors the metric sidecar. The body period sections are the grounding view; this is the query view.

provenance.description: AXIS 4 — Provenance. EDITORIAL (native ClearPoint audit) + RESOLUTION (parse confidence).

scorecard.description: Editorial: home scorecard (also origin of the primary access marking).

lastUpdatedBy.description: element.lastUpdated / lastUpdatedBy — period-scoped STATUS/DATA update. Distinct from lastEditedBy.

resolved.description: Resolution: only on parsed/derived nodes — selector + confidence + evidence, or a ref.

alias.description: AXIS 5 — Vocabulary. The org's own word for this concept (glossary). `type` stays canonical for interop; `alias` is what the MCP speaks back.

customFields.description: AXIS 5 — Vocabulary. ELEMENT-LEVEL custom fields only (fieldType 'edit'/'readOnly' — one value, non-varying). Period-scoped ('update') custom fields vary over time and live in the body period sections + the history sidecar (cps.time.historyResource), NOT here. Each `name` is the org's own field label — glossary material.

measure.description: Metric detail (measures only). The GROUNDING projection lives inline in the body; this carries series definitions + evaluation rules + the analytical sidecar pointer (§6).

evaluation.description: Rules that turn a series value into a status (objectiveEvaluation). Carries direction-of-good / thresholds.

dataResource.description: Bundle-relative path or URI of the full series sidecar (data/*).

capability.description: Verb ladder (ascending). Mirrors _mcpElement.access / cps-next use-access. (_elementAccess also carries 'Limited', which projects to Browser-level here.)

to.description: Bundle-relative path of the target concept.

access.description: Per-link access (_mcpLink.access). Edge visible iff BOTH endpoints are.

fieldType.description: Value type as ClearPoint projects it (e.g. 'html', 'kanban', 'text', 'number', 'date'). The edit-vs-update MODE (element-level vs period-scoped) is carried by WHERE the field lives: cps.customFields = element-level; period sections / history sidecar = period-scoped.

evaluationRule.description: Mirrors objectiveEvaluation item — the rule that yields a status from a series.

status.description: Resolved status name for this period (short; full narrative in the body).

personStamp.description: Who + when. `name` is the grounding-facing string (ClearPoint stores a userId; the emitter resolves it, as _mcpElement resolves owner).
